purpose: Test whether the failed uniform-N241 C2B face representation is repaired by aligning the two physical C0 conductivity-derivative joins, without increasing table density, memory or runtime iteration count.

candidate.lookup_cost: O(1) piecewise segment selection plus bilinear interpolation

probes: Reuse the exact frozen C2B face-characterization probes, including explicit -40 cm and -4 cm join probes. This is characterization, not a holdout.
hard_rules: Do not change the H_ENPR/SVG2006 physical closure.
Do not increase N above 241 in this gate.
Do not relax any C1R face-flux threshold.
Do not add runtime root finding or nonlinear iteration.
Do not treat characterization probes as a future holdout.
If R1 passes, freeze a separate fresh face-flux holdout before any qualification claim.
If R1 fails broadly away from the exact joins, stop seam-only refinement and investigate a different representation rather than silently densifying the table.
scope_guard: Representation characterization only; no transient, groundwater, production or empirical hydraulic validation claim.
